summary.text: Mike Hilgers is the Republican incumbent Attorney General of Nebraska, seeking a second term. A former state senator who served as Speaker of the Legislature, he says he wants to see through pending matters including a U.S. Supreme Court case over Colorado's South Platte River water and his litigation against TikTok.

paragraphs.text: Served six years in the Nebraska Legislature before becoming Attorney General, including two years as speaker.
Elected Attorney General in 2022 with 69.7% of the vote.

sources.title: Nebraska attorney general candidates take differing approaches to campaign trail
